redaction: no secret value is written in any file here: file:line and kind only

files.candidate_files.tsv: every file of the proposed public tree: public path, bytes, sha256, decision (include / redact / review / exclude), group, source path, note
files.candidate_summary.json: totals by decision and group, largest files, binaries, the tree spec, the reference prover and gate
files.secret_scan_hits.tsv: redacted scan hits over the candidate tree
files.secret_scan_summary.json: hit counts per kind / severity and the exact patterns
files.abs_path_counts.tsv: per-file counts of /home/victor and Windows-user paths (low risk; parametrise before release)
files.personal_keyword_counts.tsv: per-file counts of funding / employment / patent / Telegram / owner-machine words (docs review aid; most 'partner' hits are technical)
files.name_flags.json: sensitive file names in and around the tree (names only, never opened)
files.history_scan.json: bounded, redacted search of all git refs: paths ever committed, sensitive names ever committed, pickaxe hits
files.rust_licences.tsv: 371 distinct crates from 11 Cargo.lock files with licence and class
files.python_licences.tsv: app venv and system-python packages with licence
files.licence_summary.json: licence counts, flagged crates / packages, RISC Zero crates
files.model_licences.json: per-model licence, evidence and redistribution advice
files.excluded_areas.json: what stays out and why, with du sizes
files.build_inventory.py: regenerates candidate / scan files; --scan-tree re-scans a built snapshot
files.*.log, scan_history.done: guard logs of the runs that produced these files
